notes.title: Game Update #3
notes.notes: [h3]Fixed:[/h3][list][*][p]Aura passive of the defense tower "Bastion" was not taking effect.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Game Update #2
notes.notes: [h3][b]Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]A passive ability that triggers when a monster is killed by friendly damage was incorrectly targeting towers, leading to towers being destroyed.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The type restriction for the purification effect of aqua-element skill was not taking effect.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]When creating a new game, game names containing abnormal characters could cause save files to fail to read correctly.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]A crash issue that could occur when a large number of bouncing projectiles attack a large number of monsters.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Changes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The tower "Tsunami" had an incorrect range that far exceeded the normal value, which has now been adjusted back.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Reduced the frequency of effects triggered by the interaction between spark and aqua elements, while increasing the damage they deal. Overall damage has been improved.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Features[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Add Save Management.[/p][list][*][p][b]Rename[/b]: Modify the display name of save files in the game.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Copy Path[/b]: Copy the save file path to the system clipboard.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Create Copy[/b]: Generate a duplicate of the save file.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Game Update
notes.notes: [p][b]Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where a time zone problem caused a black screen on startup.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adjusted the attack speed value provided by the aura of the high - level Wind Tower.[/p][/*][/list]
